source.subject: Sanitized health platform SAFE round
source.sourceText: Sanitized Health builds a care coordination platform for specialty clinics. The company sells annual software subscriptions plus paid deployment services. We are raising a $3M SAFE at a $25M valuation cap. Northstar Ventures is leading with a $1M investment. We have $2.35M committed and $650K remaining to close by year end. No Beaman Ventures check size has been proposed. Attachment Sanitized Health Deck.pdf: Page 4: Annual recurring revenue reached $1.4M, up 75% year over year. Page 7: The platform is deployed across 18 clinics under multi-year contracts. Page 10: Proceeds will fund product integrations and enterprise sales hiring.
